name: Bandit
description: In the shadow-haunted edges of the Northern Corrupted Woods, a lone bandit prowls--an opportunist twisted as much by desperation as by the taint seeping from Malarok's dark influence. Clad in weathered leather patched with scraps of darkened hide, their garb blends into the choking underbrush and blackened foliage. Their face, half-hidden beneath a tattered hood, is marked with grime and faint traces of sickly sap that seems to cling unnaturally to their skin, a subtle sign of the creeping corruption. Eyes dart nervously, glinting with a mixture of cunning and fear, reflecting the ever-present threat of the twisted wilderness. Their hands grip a crude but sharp blade, stained with the rust and remnants of past skirmishes, while a coil of rope and a battered crossbow hang from their belt--tools of a thief who prefers ambush and escape over open confrontation. The air around them carries a faint metallic chill, as if the very atmosphere leeches warmth and vitality, a whisper of the Voidstone's pervasive blight. This bandit moves with practiced stealth, pausing to listen to the eerie chorus of corrupted creatures and the rustling of thorny briars, ever wary of both the supernatural horrors and the desperate souls that roam these forsaken woods. Their presence is a grim reminder that corruption breeds not only monsters but the erosion of humanity itself.
